Hi Walid,

No problem, here it is in writing.

We run outbound email campaigns for 3PLs and warehousing operators. We build the target list around your fulfilment capacity and the customer types you want, handle the sending infrastructure and inbox health, then manage the replies so you only see genuine enquiries.

Typical setup is 150k to 250k emails a month, and most clients see around 50 qualified conversations inside 90 days.

Here's an overview if it's useful: https://koldify.io

If any questions come up, just reply here and I'll answer by email. No call needed.

Victoria
